# The image repositories this organisation builds, and so the ones that can be expected to
# publish a configuration contract.
#
# Read by `just check-contract-coverage`. A chart pinning any image matched here must carry a
# `config-contract.yaml` — either declaring what its rendered configuration has to satisfy, or
# opting out explicitly with `documents: []` and a `reason`. A chart pinning only third-party
# images (paperless-ngx, teamspeak, postgres) needs nothing: nobody publishes a contract for
# them, and a gate that demanded one would be asking for a file that could only say "no".
#
# The pattern language is the same one `external.ignore` uses inside a contract, and
# deliberately so: a trailing `*` matches any suffix, and anything else is an exact repository.
# Not fnmatch, not a regex — a suppression list is only reviewable if a reader can tell at a
# glance what it covers.
#
# Matched against `image.repository` as written in a chart's `values.yaml`, which is the
# registry-less form for Docker Hub and the fully qualified one everywhere else.

timschoenle/*
timmi6790/*
ghcr.io/timschoenle/*
ghcr.io/timmi6790/*
